description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionModified class, representing an event emitted after a Connection object is modified. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing the Connection data.

classes.name: ConnectionModified
classes.description: Represents an event indicating a Connection has been modified, with methods for creation, JSON deserialization, and data access.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionModified event with specified Connection and headers, optionally with timestamp.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a ConnectionModified event from a JSON string or object, with associated headers.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Connection associated with this event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the Connection entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path for this event, which is empty.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new event instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends the Connection payload to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of ConnectionModified.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code for the event.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the event.
